text: Mulching is a key component of gardening, as it helps to retain moisture, suppress weeds, and create a visually appealing environment. Composting is another crucial aspect of gardening, as it helps to break down organic materials, release nutrients, and create a nutrient-dense soil amendment. Additionally, incorporating a diversity of plants and insects in your garden can provide a rich and varied ecosystem. Ultimately, gardening requires careful planning and attention to detail to ensure that your garden thrives and produces the desired outcomes.
